bugs.what: The Watch Checkpoint scene (Wardmoor north road, smuggler-boots flavor encounter) is a pure toll/friction node with no reward or story payoff either way — succeeding or paying just removes an artificial roadblock and can cost faction standing on a natural-1 fail, which feels like a punishing dead end rather than content.

Cross-region navigation (e.g. finding the unmarked path from Camp Gallows to the Iron Downs, or from Wardmoor's parade ground to the oath-stone/Boot-Track Hollow) required blind directional wandering across many rooms with no 'get your bearings' available until deep inside the area, unlike the Vale's Ashwood which had it near the entrance.

confusions: The travel menu's numbered pagination reuses option numbers across pages (e.g. option 21 sometimes means 'more places' and sometimes a specific destination depending on list length), which made it easy to misclick while trying to page through a long list of known locations.

It wasn't obvious upfront that returning the Hollow King's crown (to rest him deeper) would later lock out the 'sit the hollow seat with a crown' option at the Hollow Throne — the tradeoff between early-game and end-game crown uses isn't flagged until you reach the final room and 'weigh the doors' tells you what you lack.
suggestions: Give low-value toll/flavor encounters like the Watch Checkpoint a small unique reward or story beat so failing/paying doesn't feel like pure friction.
Surface a free 'get your bearings' option earlier in unfamiliar regions, not just after already stumbling several rooms deep.
Flag major item-tradeoffs (e.g. 'this crown is needed later for X ending path') at the moment of the choice, not just retroactively at the final weigh-in.
Cap or reorganize the travel-menu pagination so option numbers stay stable across pages once a location list gets long.
